verdict.rationale: The skills CLI documents selective installation from a collection in three ways: the `--skill` flag, which can be repeated to name individual skills, with `'*'` reserved for installing everything; direct URL paths to a single skill inside a repo; and a `--list` option that shows what a repo contains without installing anything. A hands-on runtime probe confirmed the `--list` path, enumerating all 9 skills in a repo without installing any of them, and the per-skill flag also works in non-interactive CI mode.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install only the specific skills I want from a collection instead of taking the whole bundle

citations.quote: Install specific skills by name (use `'*'` for all skills)
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill frontend-design --skill skill-creator
enumerated all 9 skills in a public repo — each with its name and full trigger description — WITHOUT installing anything
